description: This Java class 'InitializationLoader' is responsible for initializing the database and security groups, permissions, and loading test data during application startup. It uses Spring annotations like @Component, @Autowired, and @PostConstruct to manage dependencies and lifecycle. The class sets up default admin and customer groups, permissions, and populates initial data if the database is empty, handling configuration for test data population.

classes.name: InitializationLoader
classes.description: Spring-managed component responsible for setting up initial database state, security groups, permissions, and optionally loading test data at application startup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Post-construct method that checks if the database is empty, populates it, creates security groups and permissions, and loads test data if configured.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads initial test data into the system if configured to do so, and marks the configuration as loaded.
